stations.title: Bartek
stations.say: Films are three in a row on a phone.

stations.title: Phone layout
stations.text: Written in 2021: one column on a phone.

captions: Bartek opens the Wrenfield's page on his phone between reels.
The phone layout is in the stylesheet, yet the films are still squeezed three in a row.
You find the rule that beats the phone layout and fix it, without touching wide screens.
On the phone the films sit one above the other, and the footer is stacked.
Same stylesheet. The phone layout now arrives on phones and stays off wider screens.
